ig_caption:
An agent is just a loop that doesn't stop until the job is done 🔁

Real trace from my small harness:
1️⃣ the model doesn't answer, it asks for a tool
2️⃣ the harness runs it and feeds the result back
3️⃣ the model reads it, and only now answers

Think. Act. Observe. Repeat.
⚠️ The most important line: MAX_STEPS. Without it, one confused model loops forever and burns your budget.

Part 4/6 of Agent Harness 101. Ask me anything in the comments, I answer every one.
